mapper.select: SELECT WORK_HIST_NO , PRJ_NO , USER_ID , WORK_DATE , WORK_TABLE , WORK_TYPE , WORK_TARGET FROM WORK_HISTORY
SELECT WORK_HIST_NO , PRJ_NO , USER_ID , WORK_DATE , WORK_TABLE , WORK_TYPE , WORK_TARGET FROM WORK_HISTORY WHERE PRJ_NO = #{prjNo}
SELECT WORK_HIST_NO , PRJ_NO , USER_ID , WORK_DATE , WORK_TABLE , WORK_TYPE , WORK_TARGET FROM WORK_HISTORY WHERE WORK_HIST_NO = #{workHistNo}
SELECT * FROM WORK_HISTORY WHERE PRJ_NO = #{prjNo} ORDER BY WORK_DATE DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT wh.WORK_HIST_NO, wh.PRJ_NO, p.PROJECT_NAME AS PRJ_NAME, wh.USER_ID, pm.USER_NAME, wh.WORK_DATE, wh.WORK_TABLE, wh.WORK_TYPE, wh.WORK_TARGET, wh.WORK_CONTENT FROM WORK_HISTORY wh LEFT JOIN PROJECT p ON wh.PRJ_NO = p.PRJ_NO LEFT JOIN PRJ_MEM pm ON wh.USER_ID = pm.USER_ID AND wh.PRJ_NO = pm.PRJ_NO WHERE wh.WORK_DATE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY wh.WORK_DATE DESC )
WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT wh.WORK_HIST_NO, wh.PRJ_NO, p.PROJECT_NAME AS PRJ_NAME, wh.USER_ID, pm.USER_NAME, wh.WORK_DATE, wh.WORK_TABLE, wh.WORK_TYPE, wh.WORK_TARGET, wh.WORK_CONTENT FROM WORK_HISTORY wh LEFT JOIN PROJECT p ON wh.PRJ_NO = p.PRJ_NO LEFT JOIN PRJ_MEM pm ON wh.USER_ID = pm.USER_ID AND wh.PRJ_NO = pm.PRJ_NO WHERE wh.PRJ_NO = #{projectId} AND wh.WORK_DATE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY wh.WORK_DATE DESC )
WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
